description: Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.
Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.
Notification chime — alert, message-in, toast/badge appears. Sync to the element entering.
Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.
